riskStatement: Concentration risk in lending portfolio with top 10 borrowers accounting for 45% of total advances
mitigationPlan: Implement exposure limits per borrower group. Diversify portfolio across sectors. Enhanced monitoring of large exposures.

kris.name: Top 10 Borrower Concentration %
kris.description: Percentage of total advances held by top 10 borrowers

kris.name: Single Borrower Limit Breach Count
kris.description: Number of borrowers exceeding single borrower exposure limit

riskStatement: Rising NPA ratio due to slowdown in recovery efforts and economic headwinds in certain sectors
mitigationPlan: Strengthen recovery mechanism. Early warning system for SMA accounts. Sector-wise stress testing.

kris.name: Gross NPA Ratio %
kris.description: Gross NPAs as percentage of total advances

riskStatement: Inadequate collateral valuation and documentation in 15% of reviewed loan files
mitigationPlan: Mandatory re-valuation for properties older than 3 years. Empaneled valuers list. Documentation checklist enforcement.

kris.name: Collateral Documentation Gap %
kris.description: Percentage of loans with incomplete collateral documentation

riskStatement: Cash handling discrepancies and retention limit breaches at branch level
mitigationPlan: Daily cash reconciliation. Automated alerts for retention limit. Dual custody enforcement.

kris.name: Cash Variance Frequency
kris.description: Number of cash variance instances per month

riskStatement: Fraud risk due to gaps in transaction monitoring and exception reporting
mitigationPlan: Implement automated transaction monitoring. Regular exception report review. Mandatory staff rotation in sensitive roles.

kris.name: Unreviewed Exception Reports Count
kris.description: Number of exception reports pending review > 7 days

riskStatement: IT system downtime and data loss risk due to inadequate disaster recovery preparedness
mitigationPlan: DR site activation within 4 hours. Quarterly DR drills. Offsite backup verification.

kris.name: DR Drill Success Rate %
kris.description: Percentage of successful DR drills in last 4 quarters

riskStatement: KYC documentation gaps and delayed periodic KYC updates for high-risk customers
mitigationPlan: Automated KYC expiry alerts. Dedicated KYC team. Account freeze for non-compliant accounts.

kris.name: KYC Overdue Accounts %
kris.description: Percentage of accounts with overdue KYC updates

riskStatement: Delays in STR (Suspicious Transaction Report) filing to FIU-IND beyond regulatory timelines
mitigationPlan: Automated STR workflow. Training on red flag identification. Monthly compliance review.

kris.name: STR Filing Delay Days (Avg)
kris.description: Average delay in STR filing beyond 7-day timeline

riskStatement: Interest rate risk due to asset-liability maturity mismatch in treasury portfolio
mitigationPlan: ALM gap analysis. Duration matching strategy. Interest rate hedging instruments.

riskStatement: Liquidity risk due to tight CRR/SLR maintenance and seasonal deposit withdrawal patterns
mitigationPlan: Maintain liquidity buffer. Seasonal cash flow forecasting. Contingency funding plan.

kris.name: LCR (Liquidity Coverage Ratio) %
kris.description: High-quality liquid assets / Net cash outflows (30 days)

riskStatement: Cyber security threats including phishing, ransomware, and unauthorized access attempts
mitigationPlan: Multi-factor authentication. Regular vulnerability scans. Security awareness training. Incident response plan.

kris.name: Cyber Incident Count
kris.description: Number of cyber security incidents per quarter

riskStatement: Data loss or corruption risk due to inadequate backup procedures and testing
mitigationPlan: Daily incremental backup. Weekly full backup. Monthly restore testing. Offsite backup storage.

kris.name: Backup Success Rate %
kris.description: Percentage of successful backups in last 30 days
